title: Anvilmaw Smith
summary: Cinderforge anvil titan
infobox: Frost magic and kiting between heavy hammer swings.
Besieged Wall, Twofold Assault, Gauntlet of Iron +1

p: Forged from slag-iron and chained to geothermal floor-vents, these lumbering constructs hammer fallen shields back into caldera armor. Their furnace chests hiss with sulfur brine before every crushing overhead blow.

Living siege-titans of the Cinderforge with iron anvils for lower jaws and smoking chimneys protruding from their spines. When they strike their own jaws with their hammer-arms, scatter immediately to avoid the shrapnel.
Hammers its own jaw, spraying molten sparks in a 3.5-radius for 20 fire/physical damage and stunning 1.5 s.
Clamps its left-arm tongs shut and raises its colossal right-arm smithing hammer toward its chin.
Titan gauntlets, obsidian mauls, gothic plate, and tier-5 gear.

title: Frontier Marksman
summary: Playable or allied unit.
infobox: Fast cavalry or pack rushers that close the gap.

p: Trained on the sleet-swept palisades of Thornwick, frontier marksmen keep their bowstrings waxed with mutton tallow and count every bodkin arrow against their pay. In open skirmishes they pick off casters before closing ranks.

title: Ash Weaver
summary: Flame curse caster
infobox: Interrupting casts and closing into melee range.

p: Disgraced arcanists of the Caldera Schism who stitched copper grounding-wire into their own robes to channel magma pressure. They unravel ward-lines from afar, leaving scorched ozone and brittle cinder in their wake.

Four-armed cinder-cultists who spin incandescent filaments of glass and soot above their cowls. Their fire-webs entangle and immolate entire squads; snipe them early or use Wind Ward to deflect their casts.
Throws a burning web (radius 2.5) that roots foes for 3 s and deals 5 fire damage/s.
All four spider-like arms cross overhead, pulling a bright orange net from its smoking left mantle.
Silk gloves, velvet mantles, fire tomes, and wands.

title: Ashkarath, the Cinder King
summary: Act 4 Final Boss: Cinder Throne (Hellfire breath, Fire Ring, Bone Prison, Red Lightning)
infobox: Frost damage, disciplined dispersion against fire rings, and focus fire during vents.

p: First Warden of the Seven Anchor Seals, Ashkarath has stood watch over the Obsidian Dais for four centuries as his flesh calcified into meteoric slag. He burns all challengers to keep the Primordial Ember from consuming the northern realm.

BOSS (Act IV). The three-meter sovereign of the Obsidian Throne, crowned with a blazing halo of fused iron swords and wielding four arms. Break his Bone Prisons immediately so your squad is not trapped inside his Hellfire Breath and Red Lightning rings.
Cages the furthest target in bone, then sweeps a 6-tile molten greatsword arc for 38 fire/astral damage.
The living dragon-skull on his left shoulder belches black smoke as the sword-halo above his head blazes white.
Act IV Unique items, sovereign artifacts, and tier-5 masterworks.
First Warden of the Anchor Seals

list: Magma surges from the throne vents, scorching your flesh!
Ashkarath shatters the conduit pillars, unleashing primordial fury!
Return to the magma. The unchained fire is eternal.

title: Basalt Brute
summary: Siege breaker giant
infobox: Arcane and lightning spells that crack its mineral seams.
Heartland March, Besieged Wall, Gauntlet of Iron

p: Quarried from volcanic fault-lines and animated by third-dynasty telluric wedges, a basalt brute feels neither cold nor blade-nick. Its stone fists shatter shield walls like dry slate.

Walking siege-engines of hexagonal black rock animated by the caldera's deep pressure. Their battering-ram right arms can shatter a shield-wall in one blow; immobilize their wide feet with ice magic and chip them down from range.
Slams its right arm into the earth, dealing 22 damage in a 4-tile line and knocking down for 2.5 s.
Magma flares brightly between the hexagonal pillars on its back as it drags its ram-arm back.
Warhammers, greatmauls, tower shields, and plate mail.

title: Briar Hound
summary: Fast pack rusher
infobox: Blood at the Ford, Lantern Passage, Alder Bridge

p: Lean, thorn-matted curs that hunt the bog-iron ditches along the Alder River in starving packs. They scent spilled tallow and bloodied bandages from half a league downwind.

Feral border curs colonized by parasitic iron-bramble that grows directly through their ribs. They hunt in starving packs along the Sunken Ford; cut them down with fire or wide-sweeping blades before they surround isolated archers.
Leaps 4 tiles to bite for 10 damage and inflicts 2 bleed/s for 4 s.
Lowers its snout to the dirt as the wooden spine-thorns rattle violently.
Light hides, thorny kindling, and copper coins swallowed from dead scouts.

title: Cinder Shaman
summary: Cinder Shaman unit.
infobox: Frost bolts and early sniping before they rally allies.

p: Hunched pyromancers who carry clay braziers of peat-charcoal to ignite ambush lines in damp timberlands. Once their kind falls, scattered warbands lose both cohesion and torchlight.

title: Cinderhorn
summary: Inferno-breathing megademon
infobox: Cold magic and armored frontliners holding choke points.

p: Horned beasts born in the sulfurous vents beneath the Gauntlet of Iron, their ribs glowing like banked forge coals. They charge through smoke clouds and exhale superheated grit.

Towering furnace-chested megademons of the caldera floor, swinging chained cast-iron weights from their right arms. Stay clear of their mid-range flail sweeps and douse their open ribcage fires with Ice Storm or Blizzard.
Exhales a wide 4-tile cone of hellfire from its chest for 25 fire damage, melting 4 armor.
Beats its chained iron weight against its hooves as the open furnace in its chest roars white.
Endgame weapons, fire-resistant greaves, and demon-forged charms.

title: Cinderling
summary: Fire bolt harrier
infobox: Lantern Passage, Ironhide Hunt, Ashbrook Retreat +1

p: Skittering sparks given sinew around cracked ley-valves, cinderlings swarm overpowder wagons and dry thatch. A single crushed ember-sac scatters harmlessly, yet dozens overwhelm careless squads.

Malformed volcanic homunculi with smoking chimney-skulls and a dragging left arm of molten slag. They scurry around the edges of battle hurling magma globs; a single Frost Bolt will crack their brittle crust.
Flings molten rock at a 1.5-radius spot (range 6) for 11 fire damage, leaving burning ground for 4 s.
Spins in a tight circle, scooping glowing magma with its long left arm.
Fire scrolls, ember charms, and small piles of fused gold.

title: Scale Viper
summary: Venomous desert lunger
infobox: Fire and ranged volleys before they close to strike.
Twin Passes, Mire Convoy, Granary Raid +1

p: Alkali-crusted serpents that coil beneath sun-baked limestone slabs along the Redmarsh causeways. Their hooked fangs inject a coagulant venom that turns blood to silt within minutes.

Armored desert serpents that rear up on clawed forelimbs and sweep with a halberd-like bone blade at the tip of their tails. Their venom blinds and weakens; keep antidotes or Blessing active on your point man.
Lunges 3 tiles and whips its tail for 14 damage plus 3 poison/s for 6 s.
Coils high on its tail, flaring its spiked cobra hood wide as the tail-blade glints.
Scale armor, poison charms, and agile weapons.

title: Crowned Maw
summary: Apex pack hunter
infobox: Stuns, slow effects, and concentrated ranged fire.
Heartland March, Besieged Wall, Three-Roads Siege

p: Crested apex predators of the high basalt ridges, scarred by decades of territorial duels over hot-spring carrion. Their jagged jaws snap bronze greaves in a single lunge.

Apex pack-leaders of the volcanic foothills bearing a jagged collar of bone horns behind their half-flayed skulls. They smell wounded soldiers across the map and sprint to finish them; guard your injured behind Stone Skin.
Leaps 6 tiles to an injured target, dealing 19 damage (28 if target is below 50% HP).
Flares its neck-crown of bone horns wide while crimson saliva drips from its flayed right jaw.
High-tier daggers, shadow masks, and lifesteal rings.

title: Dread Knight
summary: Heavy armored hell vanguard
infobox: Armor-piercing spells and sustained lightning arcs.
Flight of Malrik, Gauntlet of Iron, Three-Roads Siege +2

p: Oath-bound champions of the First Watch whose plates were riveted shut after the Caldera Schism. They march in dead silence, answering only to iron-stamped probate warrants.

Elite vanguard champions of the Infernal Citadel clad in meteoric black iron and skull-faced pauldrons. Their two-handed battleaxes cleave through shields; slow them with Blizzard and focus them down with astral magic.
Swings its greataxe for 22 physical/fire damage and ignites the ground for 5 fire/s over 5 s.
The fiery runes on its right pauldron flare crimson as it steps forward with a two-handed grip.
Zweihanders, decapitator axes, full plate, and champion rings.

title: Dune Beast
summary: Oasis leaper & pack prowler
infobox: Earth-binding slows and disciplined spear formations.
Redmarsh Border, Granary Raid, Fleeing Column

p: Broad-pawed stalkers of the evaporated inland sea, capable of bounding across shifting salt-crusts without sinking. Caravaneers hang copper bells on their mules to warn of a pack's approach.

Sail-backed oasis predators whose crocodile jaws occupy nearly half their body length. They leap over frontline shields to snap at wounded soldiers; focus fire on them the moment their dorsal fin breaks the scrub.
Jumps 5 tiles over obstacles to bite for 16 physical damage, pinning the target for 2 s.
Flattens its tall dorsal sail and flares the three bone gill-spikes on its left neck.
Heavy hides, brigandines, and body-enhancing gear.

title: Dune Lurker
summary: Ambush striker
infobox: Area sweeps and keeping scouts ahead of the column.
Scattered Scouts, Granary Raid, Fleeing Column

p: Scavengers wrapped in salt-stiffened hides who bury themselves beside dry cisterns to ambush stray outriders. They strip canteens and copper fittings before dragging bodies into the scree.

Ochre-shelled desert mantids that lie buried up to their eyes in the dry creek beds of Bracken Basin. They erupt beneath stragglers with cross-scythe slashes; keep Stone Skin on your rear guard when crossing sand.
Burrows and erupts behind the lowest-armor target within 5 tiles for 16 slashing damage.
Crosses its oversized serrated right scythe over its chest and sinks into the sand.
Poignards, studded leather, and agility gear.

title: Dune Scarab
summary: Lightning discharge beetle
infobox: Ranged attacks that avoid close-quarters static bursts.
Twin Passes, Wardstone Rupture, Deep Quarry

p: Carapaced beetles that graze on vitrified slag near shattered quartz wardstones, storing static charge in their wing-cases. When cracked open, they vent sharp arcs of blue lightning.

Carapace-plated beetles with forked copper horns that act as living Leyden jars. Striking their cracked right shell with metal weapons triggers a static backfire; engage them with ranged magic or wooden staves.
Launches a slow lightning orb (range 7) that explodes for 15 air damage in a 2-tile radius.
A blinding cyan arc forms between the tips of its forked copper horn.
Rings, amulets, lightning scrolls, and copper bands.

title: Ash-Tongue Shaman
summary: Firebolt chanter & reviver
infobox: Quick flanking strikes and silencing magic.
Nightfall at Ravenwatch, The Sunken Sanctum, Undervault Links +1

p: Outcast ritualists who barter salt-rations for stolen mint copper and chant over bone talismans in ruined tollhouses. Their firebolts blister wet leather and panic poorly trained levies.

Hedge-priests of the ash-cults who carry burning bone-totems strapped to their spines. Always kill the Shaman first; if left chanting in the rear, he will endlessly re-ignite fallen hounds and raiders.
Restores a fallen non-boss enemy within 5 tiles to 50% HP with a fiery aura.
Raises his charred right-hand staff high as the skull-totem on his back belches orange flame.
Spell scrolls, mage staves, ember charms, and mana potions.

title: Bog Dartblower
summary: Jungle poison dart skirmisher
infobox: Scattered Scouts, Hexer's Hollow, Field Infirmary

p: Wiry reed-hunters of the coastal fens who dip bone needles in fermented marsh-toad bile. They dart between sunken pilings, bleeding armored soldiers through visor slits.

Diminutive swamp-dwellers concealed behind ritual masks twice their own height. They kite relentlessly through the reeds while spitting neurotoxic needles; use area-of-effect Fireballs or fast archers to sweep them clear.
Shoots a toxic dart (range 7) for 7 damage that slows by 40% and poisons (2/s) for 6 s.
Hops backward on one foot and steadies the long bamboo pipe with both hands.
Stilettos, poison scrolls, light boots, and wooden charms.

title: Flintback
summary: Armoured frontliner
infobox: Elemental magic that bypasses heavy physical plating.
Blood at the Ford, Greywood Supply, Ironhide Hunt

p: Thick-shelled mire beasts whose dorsal plates spark when struck by steel, earning their name from desperate border pickets. They anchor enemy lines while lighter scavengers flank.

Lumbering quarry-beasts whose dorsal hides have calcified into overlapping slabs of grey chert. Arrows and light swords glance harmlessly off their posture; soften them with crushing maces or lightning magic.
Charges 3 tiles and bashes for 15 physical damage, stunning for 2 s.
Drags its knuckles in the gravel and tilts its tall left shoulder-stone forward.
Heavy shields, iron ore fragments, and dented warrior helms.

title: Frost Bell
summary: Chilling astral bell
infobox: Fire spells and shattering blunt weapons.
Sundered Ranks, Sunken Citadel, Hourglass Rescue +1

p: Hollow bronze resonators torn from drowned coastal belfries and hung with rime-crusted telluric wire. Every chime drains warmth from the air and numbs bow-hands.

Haunted liturgical bronze bells torn from drowned coastal chapels, levitating on chains of rime. When their skull-clappers strike, the sound freezes mana and muscle alike; shatter their cracked right flanks with heavy maces.
Rings a 4-radius sonic wave dealing 15 cold damage and adding 15 to all spell cooldowns.
Tilts sharply backward as the glowing frost-skull clapper swings out through the right-side crack.
Spell-mirrors, astral medallions, and water tomes.

title: Glasswing
summary: Swift air skirmisher
infobox: Ranged archers and rapid lightning strikes.

p: Translucent coastal flyers whose wings hum like taut copper wire in storm squalls. They dive out of sea-fog to slash exposed necks and scatter pack animals.

High-altitude predators with four razor-edged wings of translucent silica. They hover over impassable terrain to pelt troops with obsidian tail-shards; bring them down with accurate bowfire or instant lightning spells.
Fires a glass shard from 6 tiles away for 12 damage that inflicts 3 bleed/s for 4 s.
Whip-curls its double obsidian tail-stinger over its head while hovering stationary.
Quartz focuses, swift boots, and high-accuracy daggers.

title: Gloom Stag
summary: Forest flanker
infobox: Greywood Supply, Split Vanguard, Ironhide Hunt +1

p: Gaunt antlered beasts of the Greywood timberlands, their racks draped in black moss and corroded iron snares. Driven mad by winter starvation, they gore loggers and patrols alike.

Gaunt, long-legged cervids of the deep Greywood whose deadwood antlers trail ribbons of narcotic shadow-mist. They ignore the frontline to gore back-row mages; keep a reserve pikeman or Stone Curse ready.
Blinks through mist for 4 tiles and gores for 15 astral/physical damage, silencing for 3 s.
The skull tangled in its wide left antler flares violet as the stag lowers its rack.
Stalker hoods, bows, agility rings, and astral charms.

title: Border Gnoll
summary: Gnoll unit.
infobox: Disciplined melee lines and targeting pack leaders.

p: Hired by Morvessa with stamped mint copper, these hunched raiders haunt the Sunken Ford and Alder River toll-roads. They fight viciously for looted rations but break when their chieftains fall.

title: Wardstone Golem
summary: Playable or allied unit.
infobox: Sustained lightning and high-tier armor-piercing strikes.

p: A towering frame of quarried granite bound with copper bands and calibrated quartz lenses by Conclave artificers. Built to absorb siege bolts, it marches without fatigue or fear.

title: Gorrathul, the Sand Glutton
summary: Act 2 Final Boss: Gullet of Dunes (Holy Freeze slow aura, burrow charge, acid cleave)
infobox: Fire damage, mobility to evade subterranean charges, and breaking his freeze aura.

p: Castellan of Ironheart Bastion, Gorrathul locked the mountain sluices and starved the salt-parishes to hide that his legendary cisterns silted dry years ago. Swollen with alkali brine and ancient wards, he crushes any army climbing the twin causeways.

BOSS (Act II). A four-armed desert abomination crowned with golden obelisks, possessing a second vertical maw down its belly that radiates an unnatural heat-sink chill. Avoid standing directly in front of its belly-maw and scatter when it burrows.
Burrows and erupts beneath the party for 32 damage, pulling units inward toward its freezing belly-maw.
The vertical maw on its stomach yawns wide as all four arms—including the giant right scorpion pincer—dig in.
Act II Unique items, ancient desert gold, and high-tier charms.
Warden of the Forked Cisterns

list: Gorrathul's heavy gauntlet crushes your breastplate!
The warlord slams his fists into the causeway, raining iron shrapnel!
Redmarsh is ours. Your corpse feeds the smelters.

title: Crypt Embalmer
summary: Ancient crypt embalmer & reviver
infobox: Fire that ignites their pitch-soaked wrappings.
Wardstone Rupture, Deep Quarry, Fork of Spears

p: Third-Dynasty probate bailiffs preserved in bitumen and copper-wire shrouds to audit unpaid granary liens beyond death. They raise fallen debtors until their tally-tablets are shattered.

High mortuary priests of the Redmarsh dynasties whose hollowed left ribs house nests of venomous copperheads. They raise fallen skeletons and suffocate the living in bitumen fumes; cleanse them from afar with fire.
Exhales necrotic mist and snakes in a 3-tile cone for 16 poison damage, preventing healing for 6 s.
Pulls open its bandaged left ribcage as green smoke pours from beneath its golden crown.
Ancient gold rings, tomes of resurrection, and ornate staves.

title: Hollow King
summary: Undead monarch lord
infobox: Fire magic and kiting during heavy swings.
Hourglass Rescue, Riverlock Crossing, High-Stakes Gambit

p: Crowned remnants of sovereigns who defaulted on the caldera maintenance tithe and were beheaded in iron collars. Cold frost bleeds from their empty ribcages with every sweeping greatsword arc.

Fallen petty-monarchs of the coastal keeps whose iron crowns were hammered directly into their skulls. Impervious to fear and cold, their royal maces shatter bone; kite them with Haste and melt their plate with fire.
Crushes the ground (radius 2.5) for 22 physical/cold damage and slows movement by 50% for 5 s.
Raises his royal mace with both hands as the three impaled swords in his left shoulder glow cyan.
Executioner blades, gothic plate, dread helms, and royal signets.

title: Hollow Knight
summary: Disciplined blade
infobox: Pledge at Oakhaven, Sundered Ranks, Field Infirmary +2

p: Indebted men-at-arms whose skeletons remain legally bound to guard ossuary gates under Probate Debt Law. Rusted mail still clings to their ribs, rattling in strict formation.

Suits of imperial border-plate animated by the muscle-memory of soldiers who refused to yield their posts. Though missing their left arms, they drag greatswords that cleave through two ranks at once; melt their joints with fire or acid.
Cleaves a 180-degree frontal arc for 17 physical damage, ignoring 3 armor.
Drags the greatsword behind its right heel, drawing a shower of blue sparks on the stone.
Knight swords, plate armor, steel helms, and gauntlets.

title: Spite Imp
summary: Playable or allied unit.
infobox: Frost bolts and fast ranged volleys.

p: Wiry, soot-stained familiars conjured from unstable telluric vents to harass supply trains and siphon lamp oil. They cackle from rooftops and fling sparks before darting out of reach.

title: Ironbark
summary: Ancient ward treant
infobox: Fire magic and sustained slashing blows.
Cinder Wards, Sundered Ranks, Hourglass Rescue +2

p: Centuries-old oaks rooted over bog-iron seams, their sap thickened with mineral ore until axes ring uselessly against their trunks. They awaken only when wildfires or warbands threaten deep groves.

Centuries-old coastal ward-trees whose sap has been replaced by bog-iron and whose left trunks are armored with ancient bronze shields. Conventional arrows cannot pierce them; use armor-shredding mauls or intense fire.
Sweeps both knee-length branch arms for 20 physical damage and pushes foes back 3 tiles.
The emerald hollow in its chest flares brightly as the bronze shields on its left side clang together.
Tower shields, thorn staves, and high-tier defensive charms.

title: Lantern Eel
summary: Bog arc striker
infobox: Earth-based strikes and insulated ranged attacks.
Pledge at Oakhaven, Sunken Citadel, Riverlock Crossing +1

p: Blind, pale eels that drift above flooded canal locks, lured by the telluric hum of copper sluice-chains. Their jawless mouths discharge stored static bolts across wet stone.

Amphibious bog-serpents that slither onto the flooded causeways of the Iron Coast at high tide. Their angler-lures discharge lethal arcs through standing water; lure them onto dry paving stones before engaging.
Shocks the target and any unit standing in water within 3 tiles for 15 lightning damage.
Whips its overhead bioluminescent lure forward as its serrated right fin fans out.
Mana potions, astral spheres, and lightning-resistant gear.

title: Conclave Arcanist
summary: Playable or allied unit.
infobox: Ambushes and fast melee rushers that break their concentration.

p: Trained in the expelled Thermodynamic Conclave, these scholars carry copper grounding-staves and smoked quartz lenses. They treat every spell as a high-pressure valve waiting to burst.

title: Maggot Swarm
summary: Toxic burrowing larva swarm

p: Blind, bloated larvae breeding in the rank sump-pits beneath Deep Quarry and Redmarsh tombs. Though slow individually, their corrosive bile eats through boot leather in seconds.

A churning carpet of pale carrion-larvae piloting a half-digested ribcage through the alkaline mud. Single-target arrows and swords are wasted on the mass; incinerate the entire cluster with Fireball or Flame Burst.
Spits digestive slime in a 2-tile cone for 10 acid damage, corroding armor by 3 for 8 s.
The giant red-jawed alpha larva rears high out of the right side of the ribcage.
Bone rings, acid scrolls, and half-digested jewelry.

title: Mire Wisp
summary: Marsh ranged caster
infobox: Whispers in the Fen, The Sunken Sanctum

p: Pocketed marsh-gas ignited by stray ley currents above peat bogs and flooded ditches. Travelers who mistake their pale glow for watch-lanterns rarely find dry footing again.
Pockets of marsh methane and spiteful lingering memory anchored inside drowned livestock skulls. Keep your formation spread out so their corpse-gas volleys cannot rot the entire vanguard at once.
Spits a glob of marsh-gas (radius 2) dealing 11 poison damage and reducing accuracy by 3 for 6 s.
The rusted left-side lantern swings wildly and flares toxic emerald.
Mana draughts, apprentice wands, and tarnished brass charms.

title: Morvessa, the Silk Widow
summary: Act 1 Final Boss: The Weeping Ossuary (Poison Spray DoT, Spine Lash knockdown, Brood Hatch summons)
infobox: Fire magic, cleansing poison quickly, and bursting down hatched broodlings.

p: High Quartermaster of the Salt Tithe, Morvessa burned the Thornwick Border Mint to conceal shaved silver groats and bred a parasitic silk-brood in the Weeping Ossuary. She audits living and dead alike with gall-ink writs and venom.

BOSS (Act I). An ancient arachnid matriarch nesting in the Weeping Ossuary beneath Ravenwatch, crowned with a cathedral spire of woven bone and silk. Destroy her brood-cocoons before they hatch and keep poison resistance high during her Venom Spray.
Lashed in a 4-tile arc for 24 poison/physical damage, knocking down for 2 s and hatching 2 spiderlings.
Rears up on all eight legs as the glowing victim-cocoon on her left abdomen pulses violet.
Act I Unique items, rare staves, and enchanted silks.
High Quartermaster of the Salt Tithe

list: Cold iron and dark sorcery pierce your mail!
Morvessa's shadow swells, unleashing a storm of bitter spite!
Ashbrook burns, and you burn with it. Pitiful.

title: Night Orchard
summary: Dark ward weaver
infobox: Starved Bastion, High-Stakes Gambit, Burning Harbor

p: Gnarled, leafless fruit trees fertilized by coastal battlefields and draped in hex-knots of salted twine. Their roots drink spilled blood and spit shadowy thorns at trespassers.
Gnarled black gallows-trees animated by the shadow covens, bearing glowing magenta skulls like ripe plums. They hurl screaming skull-fruit into your backline; chop them down with fire-enchanted axes.
Lobs 3 glowing skull-fruits at ranged targets for 14 astral damage each, inflicting Weaken.
The heavy right-side canopy shakes violently as the hanging magenta skulls shriek in unison.
Astral staves, archon wands, and dark velvet robes.

title: Pale Burrower
summary: Quarry tunneler
infobox: Fire and frost slowing their burrowing lunge.

p: Sightless subterranean crawlers unearthed when chained miners cut too deep into ironstone seams. Their chitinous foreclaws shear through timber pit-props as easily as bone.

Eyeless subterranean hulks from the Deep Quarry whose hands have ossified into broad bone shovels. They tunnel beneath shield-walls to toss infantry into the air; watch the dirt ripples and stun them as they surface.
Emerges from underground, flinging targets in a 2-tile radius upward for 16 damage and 2 s stun.
The rusted pickaxe stuck in its back vibrates and clanks against its chain before it digs.
Heavy axes, iron boots, and raw quarry gemstones.

title: Quill Fiend
summary: Rapid quill sniper
infobox: Shielded frontliners and closing into melee.
Nightfall at Ravenwatch, Split Vanguard, Alder Bridge

p: Bristled scavengers that nest in felled brushwood along the border marches, flicking barbed spines with whip-like snaps of their backs. Scouts check tree-lines twice before crossing open clearings.

Hunched, sinewy scavengers that fire calcified ribs through a hollow bone trough fused to their right forearm. Close the distance immediately with fast cavalry or hasted infantry before they pin your casters.
Fires 3 bone needles in a narrow cone for 8 piercing damage each.
Arches its spine forward until the dorsal fan of bone quills clicks upright.
Shortbows, arrows, light gloves, and bone rings.

title: Redglass Drake
summary: Highland fire drake
infobox: Frost magic and concentrated ranged volleys.
Heartland March, Flight of Malrik, Outer Rampart

p: Winged lizards whose scales fuse with airborne volcanic silica, catching torchlight like stained glass. They roost on basalt spires and rain molten cinders onto marching columns.

Lesser volcanic dragons of the Act IV ridges whose wing-membranes are sheets of razor-sharp red obsidian. Stay out of their frontal cone when their throats glow orange, and ground them with cold magic.
Breathes liquid fire in a 5-tile cone for 22 fire damage, leaving molten glass that slows for 5 s.
Rears on its hind legs, flaring its red-glass wings as magma rises up its throat.
Wyrmscale cuirasses, dragon leather mantles, and meteor tomes.

title: Rift Moth
summary: Astral drain flyer
infobox: Shattered Beacons, Flight of Malrik, Threshold Choice

p: Velvet-winged moths drawn to open ley-fissures and fractured wardstones, drinking ambient mana like nectar. Their dusted wings leave a numbing static across sword-arms.

Silent nocturnal lepidopterans from the high passes whose wing-patterns resemble staring astral eyes. Their gaze drains mana directly from casters' minds; have your archers shoot them down before your mages run dry.
Beams astral light at a target (range 7), draining 18 mana and dealing 14 astral damage.
Spreads its wings flat, causing the violet astral tear on its lower right wing to blaze.
Astral wands, mana potions, sage cowls, and mind rings.

title: Rootbound
summary: Heavy earth sentinel
infobox: Whispers in the Fen, The Sunken Sanctum, Alder Bridge +1

p: Shattered boundary stones entangled in living ash-roots and bound by old First Compact oaths. They guard forgotten forest trails long after the lords who raised them turned to dust.

Ancient boundary cairns overgrown by strangler-oaks that absorbed the frontier's spilled blood. Extremely slow but capable of flattening a shield-wall in two swings; kite them across open ground with fire magic.
Smashes a 2-tile area in front for 18 earth damage and roots targets for 3 s.
Slowly hoists its colossal right root-hammer overhead while the left shoulder-stone glows lime-green.
Oak staves, heavy shields, stone charms, and earth scrolls.

title: Ruin Mite
summary: Swarming burrower
infobox: Whispers in the Fen, Nightfall at Ravenwatch, Undervault Links

p: Fist-sized parasites infesting damp masonry in burned tollhouses and sunken vaults. Alone they are a nuisance; in swarms they strip a fallen soldier to clean bone before dawn.

Blind, sandstone-chewing arthropods that nest in the foundations of abandoned watchtowers. Individually trivial, their serrated mandibles can saw through greaves if allowed to swarm a stationary tank.
Snaps for 8 damage and reduces target's armor by 2 for 6 s.
Rears back on its hind legs and opens its oversized right mandible wide.
Low-tier boots, chipped flint daggers, and small healing draughts.

title: Salt Crab
summary: Coastal shell blocker
infobox: Blunt trauma and lightning conducted through wet shells.
Redmarsh Border, Mire Convoy, Lean Garrison +2

p: Armored crustaceans swollen to the size of millstones along Oakhaven's whale-oil breakwaters. Their calcified shells turn aside careless sword cuts while their pincers crush boat hulls.

Tidal crustaceans that build towering shells from brine-crystals and wrecked Oakhaven hull planks. Frontal physical attacks bounce off their massive left shield-claw; flank them or boil them inside their shells with lightning.
Raises its left claw for 4 s, reducing frontal damage by 70% before lunging for 13 damage.
Slams its flat salt-crystal left claw into the mud like a pavise shield.
Heavy armor, bucklers, and salt-preserved rations.

title: Sand Raider
summary: Dual-scimitar desert speedster
infobox: Frost slows and braced armored troops.
Redmarsh Border, Twin Passes, Outpost Palisade +1

p: Deserters and salt-exiles armed with twin curved blades who prey on water-convoys crossing the Redmarsh flats. They strike fast at dusk and vanish into alkali squalls.

Salt-bitten desert cutthroats wearing scarab-shell pauldrons and wielding twin curved scimitars. They sprint past slow heavy infantry to butcher archers; catch them with Haste or snare them in narrow choke points.
Dashes 4 tiles and strikes twice for 9 damage each, inflicting bleed.
Drops into a low sprinter's crouch and scrapes both scimitar blades together.
Curved blades, leather boots, gold pouches, and water draughts.

title: Silt Colossus
summary: Titanic citadel guardian

Shattered Beacons, Twofold Assault, Outer Rampart +2

p: Massive harbor-dredge automatons choked with river-mud and drowned chain links inside the Sunken Citadel. Each lumbering step shakes wet flagstones and crushes anything beneath its iron heels.

Towering citadel guardians formed from compressed river-silt and the masonry of ruined watchtowers. Physical blades sink uselessly into their mud-and-stone bulk; crack them open with Quake or concentrated Lightning.
Swings its broken stone column in a wide arc for 25 physical damage, knocking back 3 tiles.
Sand pours in a waterfall from its right shoulder as it lifts the left-hand temple pillar.
Aegis shields, colossus amulets, and high-tier earth tomes.

title: Spore Matron
summary: Earth poison hexer
infobox: Fire and ranged bursts from upwind.
Cinder Wards, Field Infirmary, Starved Bastion +1

p: Blighted fungal elders rooted in the dampest galleries of Redmarsh's undervaults, exhaling yellow clouds of choking rot. Miners seal side-tunnels with tallow-soaked planks at the first sign of their caps.

Bloated fungal colonies shaped vaguely like bent washerwomen, carrying umbrella-caps dripping with yellow mycotoxins. Never fight them in narrow corridors; burn them from maximum bow-range before their right-side sacs rupture.
Releases a 3-radius spore cloud around itself dealing 4 poison/s for 8 s and slowing by 25%.
The three glowing tumors on its right flank swell to bursting and pulse bright lime.
Earth scrolls, mage robes, and alchemical draughts.

title: Storm Kite
summary: Lightning ranged kite
infobox: Scattered Scouts, Outpost Palisade, Lean Garrison

p: Razor-winged sea-raptors that ride gale-force squalls above the Iron Coast, gathering static charge in their bronze-flecked plumage. They wheel just out of sword-reach and loose jagged arcs.

Leathery sky-rays that ride the thermal updrafts of the Redmarsh escarpments, storing static charge in their bronze-veined left wingtips. Ground them quickly or equip Storm Charms before they link lightning across your squad.
Fires a lightning bolt (range 8) for 14 air damage that jumps to 2 nearby allies for 8 damage.
Banks vertically in mid-air as blue sparks bridge its horns and forked tail.
Storm charms, air scrolls, and composite bows.

title: Stormtree
summary: Charged lightning colossus
infobox: Fire and ranged focus outside static discharge range.
Shattered Beacons, Twofold Assault, Crown of Order

p: Lightning-split coastal pines whose charred heartwood still crackles with trapped atmospheric charge. Approaching within ten paces raises the hair on a soldier's neck before the branches strike.

Colossal highland pines split down the center by perpetual lightning, holding a crackling plasma core between their halves. Never clump melee troops around their grounding chains; use earth shields and ranged fire.
Slams its branches, discharging 24 lightning damage in a 3.5-radius ring around its roots.
The plasma orb in its split crown drops downward as the heavy left iron chain glows white-hot.
Thunderstorm tomes, greatbows, and high-tier lightning charms.

title: Thorn Boar
summary: Charging bruiser
infobox: Blood at the Ford, Greywood Supply

p: Tusks notched by rusty arrowheads, these scarred boars barrel through bramble thickets along the Greywood logging tracks. Their thick hides turn aside light glancing shots.
Ill-tempered greywood swine grown massive on a diet of unburied border skirmishers and witch-hazel roots. Sidestep their straight-line gore attacks and strike their unarmored flanks.
Rushes 5 tiles in a line, dealing 14 damage and knocking targets back 2 tiles.
Paws the mud twice and drops its giant branched left tusk to knee-height.
Padded jerkins, axes, and hearty stamina-restoring rations.

title: Vesperion, the Hollow Choir
summary: Act 3 Final Boss: Drowned Choir (Ball lightning piercing, Soul Siphon mana drain, Frost Nova)
infobox: Spread formations against ball lightning and high mana reserves to endure Soul Siphon.

p: Lord Admiral of the Black Fleet, Vesperion torched Oakhaven's drydocks in a ruthless quarantine to stop mainland armies from shattering the southern caldera seals. Drowned mariners sing in his wake as lightning arcs from his flagship's copper hull.

BOSS (Act III). A six-winged spectral arch-prelate hovering above the flooded nave, bearing a towering pipe-organ of human femurs above its cowl. Interrupt its liturgical crescendos and spread out to avoid bouncing Ball Lightning and Frost Novas.
Chords the bone-organ, draining 25 mana and dealing 28 lightning/cold damage in a 4.5-radius ring.
Four main arms rise like a conductor's while spectral hands swing censers from its open right robe.
Act III Unique items, archmage regalia, and high-tier spell tomes.
Lord Admiral of the Black Blockade

list: Stellar fire obliterates your defenses in a blinding flash!
Vesperion unfurls celestial wings, raining blinding light!
Starlight consumes you. The vault remains sealed.

title: Vanguard Man-at-Arms
summary: Playable or allied unit.
infobox: Ranged kiting and sustained elemental magic.

p: Stalwart sellswords of the northern frontier who value dry bowstrings, honest silver groats, and unbroken shield lines. They hold the breach while arcanists vent telluric fire behind them.

title: Frosthorn Bruiser
summary: Heavy freezing yeti brawler
infobox: Starved Bastion, Elder Juggernaut, High-Stakes Gambit +1

p: Hulking mountain beasts driven down from alpine snowlines by four centuries of cooling winters. Frost cakes their matted shoulders, slowing the blood of any warrior caught in their grip.

Hulking alpine beasts from the peaks above Oakhaven with a solid gauntlet of blue glacier-ice encasing their left arms. Every blow chills the blood; keep Ember or Frost Charms equipped and burn through their thick white pelts.
Swings its ice-encased left arm for 20 cold/physical damage, freezing the target solid for 2.5 s.
Scrapes its forward-curving ice horns on the ground and drags its giant blue left fist back.
Frost charms, heavy axes, furs, and giant gauntlets.

title: Fen Hexer
summary: Marsh hexer & tribal elder
infobox: Immediate focus fire and stun effects.
Outpost Palisade, Wardstone Rupture, Hexer's Hollow +1

p: Masked marsh elders who brew bitter root-tonics and bind copper-wire fetishes to ward off coastal press-gangs. Their curses rot leather straps and sap a company's endurance.

Tribal elders of the Redmarsh fringes draped in crocodile jaws and bubbling alembic flasks. Their hexes rot armor and turn healing potions sour; interrupt their censer-swings or silence them from afar.
Curses a 2.5-radius area, reducing armor by 3 and dealing 9 poison damage over 8 s.
Swings the smoking left-hand skull censer in a wide violet circle overhead.
Potions, elixirs, hexing wands, and scholar hats.

title: Elder Juggernaut
summary: Primeval Titan of the Highland Cairn
infobox: Primeval Titan of the Highland Cairn
Arcane fire and sustained armor-breaking strikes along its glowing rune-seams.

p: Bound during the Age of Chains with dwarf-forged links and packed with anthracite, this primeval bedrock colossus slumbered beneath a moss-bound highland cairn above Oakhaven. Awakened in tectonic agony as the Obsidian Caldera fractured the realm, its glowing rune-seams must be shattered before its tremors collapse Harborwatch’s sea-walls.
Pebbles rattle off the fractured granite ridge as an ancient colossus heaves itself upward from a moss-bound cairn.
Even the stones of Thornvael were screaming against the Caldera. All we could do was grant it silence.

list: Tectonic Stomp: *The Elder Juggernaut raises both monolith fists skyward!* — *Jagged fissures rip across the cairn!*
*Twin granite fists slam into the highland cairn as the dying continent's tectonic agony shakes loose a storm of ancient stone.*
*Living basalt groans beneath primeval runes, splitting the ridge with jagged fissures.*
*Twin granite wardens lock shields beside the colossus as boulders cascade down the pass.*
*Its chest-core flares with blinding earth-fire—one final fracture away from eternal stillness.*
*With a long, resonant sigh of settling shale, the Elder Juggernaut returns to silent mountain stone.*

p: A palm-sized fragment of resonant highland granite humming softly with primeval earth-wards.

title: Lord-Captain Korvus
summary: The Iron Anchor, Warlord of the Eastern War Pier
infobox: The Iron Anchor, Warlord of the Eastern War Pier
Spread squads clear of burning pitch pools and break formation around his hooked anchor pulls.

p: Warlord of Harborwatch’s blazing eastern war pier during the exodus of the Iron Coast. Convinced that Thornvael must burn together rather than flee across the Western Sea, Korvus dragged twin sea-tempered iron anchors across scorched granite until Marshal Veyra’s rearguard cast him into the black surf.
Volcanic ash falls like hot sleet across Harborwatch's blazing eastern war pier as twin hooked anchors drag sparks across scorched granite.
He thought tearing down the lifeboats was courage. The people he tried to burn are already beyond his reach.

list: Hooked Anchor Pull: Chains whistle through the ash-smoke—brace your footing! — Yanked straight into the burning pitch!
Quay-Breaker Slam: Both iron anchors crash down to split the granite pier! — Shattered stone and splintered ribs!
Cowards! Running across the sea like rats off a burning hull! If Thornvael must drown in fire, then no one leaves this pier alive!
Drag them into the pitch! Anchor their bones!
Torch the eastern war pier! No mercy for the rearguard!
Every sail out there is a betrayal of the dead! Stay and burn with the continent!
The sails... past the horizon... you let them... escape a dying world...

p: A blackened naval chain-link forged from sea-tempered iron, still warm with harbor pitch.

title: Arch-Mage Malrik
summary: Grand Conspirator of the Iron Pact
infobox: Grand Conspirator of the Iron Pact
Advance swiftly up the switchbacks and interrupt his violet cipher casts before he reaches the summit portal.

p: Architect of the Caldera Schism who burned out his own eyes reading unshielded leyline codices, trading sight to feel volcanic seams through the soles of his boots. Having diverted Morvessa’s Salt Tithe to fund the Iron Pact, Malrik fled Ironcamp with the Royal Cipher-Keys and fell on the summit stairs of Ashveil Gorge.
Violet sparks scar the wind-scoured flagstones of Ashveil Gorge as a hooded sorcerer sprints toward the summit teleportation shrine.
From the Border Mint to the Caldera, every betrayal wore a neat ledger and a clean cloak.

list: Cipher Bolt: Malrik weaves violet static around the summit shrine! — Seared by stolen arcane ciphers!
You bled through three provinces to chase a shadow up Ashveil Gorge! One step onto that summit shrine and every secret of the Iron Pact vanishes!
Snipers on the switchbacks—bleed their vanguard dry!
The border ciphers were only the first ledger—you are too late to stop the Caldera!
Keep back from the teleport flagstones! I will not die on this freezing pass!
My satchel... the Royal Cipher-Keys... no, you cannot unravel what the Pact has lit...

p: A scorched leather cipher-satchel stamped with both the Southern Crown and the Iron Pact.

title: Arch-Warden Korrath
summary: The Living Law, Eternal Sentinel of the Crown Vault
infobox: The Living Law, Eternal Sentinel of the Crown Vault
Sunder the West and East Resonance Anchors first to strip his granite invulnerability, then cleanse Petrifying Stasis.

p: Three centuries of unbroken vigil inside the frozen marble cathedral of the Crown Vault turned Arch-Warden Korrath’s flesh to pale granite. Convinced that mortal freedom breeds only slaughter, he guarded the twin Resonance Anchors and the necrotic tether choking the Obsidian Caldera until the rearguard sundered his living law.
Inside the frozen marble cathedral of the Crown Vault, dust hangs motionless in pale azure light before a towering sentinel of living granite.
He turned himself to stone so he would never watch another city fall. Peace isn't a tomb.

list: Petrifying Stasis: Twin white-granite greatswords chime with freezing azure frost! — Stone creeps up your greaves—cleanse the stasis!
Judgment of the Vault: Korrath sweeps a shockwave of frozen marble across the nave! — Crushed under three centuries of law!
Three centuries of unbroken vigil turned my flesh to granite so law might outlive mortal folly. Sunder my anchors if you dare—and answer for the chaos you unchain.
While the West and East Resonance Anchors sing, no mortal blade can scratch eternal stone.
Both anchors shattered—draw close, then, and taste the twin blades of Petrified Judgment!
Without law, without stone, humanity will bleed again before the century turns!
The empire was peace... without law... without stone... you are only... dust in the wind...

p: A shard of pale marble etched with the Sigil of Order, cool to the touch and faintly humming.

title: Ember Overlord Vorak
summary: The Living Kiln, Overlord of the Furnace Heart
infobox: The Living Kiln, Overlord of the Furnace Heart
Shatter the West and East Obsidian Conduit Pillars to sever his molten regeneration and evade Meteor Rain.

p: Colossal warlord of the Furnace Heart who preached the Great Cleansing—that cities are slag, treaties are dry paper, and only volcanic fire reveals what deserves to endure. Standing before the screaming Crown of Thorns and Cinder, Vorak fed his throne on twin obsidian conduit pillars until the rearguard shattered his pylons.
Blinding orange magma churns beneath an obsidian altar as a colossal armored warlord rises before the screaming Crown of Thorns and Cinder.
Vorak wanted to melt the world into nothing. I will forge it into something no storm can ever break.

list: Meteor Rain: Vorak roars skyward as incandescent magma boulders tear loose from the cavern dome! — Crushed beneath falling volcanic fire!
Slag Wave: Vorak cleaves the flagstones, sending a rolling tide of liquid rock across the arena! — Scorched to the bone by molten slag!
Look through the eye of a smelter's kiln, mortal! Your cities are slag and your blood is fuel for the Great Cleansing—break my obsidian pylons if your bones can survive the fire!
Two obsidian conduit pillars feed my throne—cinder-imps, bury them in ash!
Both conduits broken?! Then let the cavern roof rain meteors and liquid rock!
I see your ambition beneath the soot! Reach for the Crown of Thorns and Cinder and see if it melts your hand!
Burn, then... conqueror... take the fire... and see if the crown does not melt your bones as it melted mine...

p: The Crown of Thorns and Cinder—blackened meteoric iron fused with living volcanic fire.

p: A gilded dune-scarab nested atop ruptured Redmarsh quartz conduits until its shell magnetized every brass rivet in the basin. Pursuers who close to sword-reach eat arcs of stored desert lightning off its chitin.

Moth Swarm Escort: Flanked by astral-draining Rift Moths.

Dread Vanguard: Commands an honor guard of Abyssal Dread Knights.

p: Once knight-commander of the First Watch picket holding the Obsidian Approach before the Anchor Seals cracked. Still clad in frost-rimmed coronation plate, Vaelor guards the caldera stair against living and traitor alike.

Zealot Aura: Grants Blessed Aura to his entire Dread Knight retinue.
Citadel Seal Guard: Maintains tactical distance while his knights bodyblock.

p: Last Keeper of the Seventh Seal who traded his living name to hold the Dread Knight phalanx unbroken through four sieges. From behind locked tower shields he rains Slow and Weaken hexes down the marble colonnade.

summary: Harvester of Cinders · Act 4 Super Unique

Soulfire Breath: Spectral fire strikes that scorch both health and spirit.

p: Gorgath leads the inner caldera cinderhorn pack across cooling magma channels on hoof and horn. Every wound he takes only stokes his berserk furnace brighter until the obsidian dais itself runs red.

title: Peat-Leech Matron

p: Ambushes waders from black bog-pools, latching on to drain stamina and spawn smaller bloodsuckers.
Swollen to the size of a butcher's apron on drowned livestock, these blind annelids secrete a numbing saliva that keeps victims from feeling their boots fill with blood.

title: Alder-Gnoll Skirmisher
summary: Flanks shield-walls using short curved hatchets and stolen Border Levy bucklers, retreating when outnumbered.

p: Flanks shield-walls using short curved hatchets and stolen Border Levy bucklers, retreating when outnumbered.
Paid in clipped mint copper to harass northern toll-posts, these river-hyena raiders grease their pelts with mutton fat to slip free of grappling pikemen.

title: Tollhouse Ghoul
summary: Lurks beneath collapsed bridge piers, lunging at wounded stragglers with ragged iron-stained claws.

p: Lurks beneath collapsed bridge piers, lunging at wounded stragglers with ragged iron-stained claws.
Former night-watchmen starved during the Salt Tithe who turned to gnawing tallow candles and river-carrion before rising with unbroken hunger.

title: Weir-Pike Stalker
summary: Darts out from submerged wicker fish-traps to snap at ankles and drag light infantry into deep channels.

Armored in mossy olive scales and sporting a jaw like a bear-trap, these ancient river-fish grow monstrous feeding on battle-corpses washed down from the fords.

title: Bog-Tallow Wight
summary: Advances steadily through knee-deep water, radiating a corpse-chill that stiffens bowstrings and joints.

p: Advances steadily through knee-deep water, radiating a corpse-chill that stiffens bowstrings and joints.
Preserved intact for centuries in airless peat bogs, these blackened corpses walk again whenever Ashen Coven chanters disturb the boundary cairns.

title: Slate-Cliff Harpy
summary: Swoops down canyon walls in Lantern Passage to snatch helmets and drop loose scree onto casters.

p: Swoops down canyon walls in Lantern Passage to snatch helmets and drop loose scree onto casters.
Leathery, bat-winged scavengers nesting in limestone crevices above trade defiles; they mimic guttering lantern-clicks to lure travelers off narrow ledges.

title: Charcoal Imp
summary: Scampers around abandoned quarry kilns hurling hot cinders and igniting oil-soaked brush.

p: Scampers around abandoned quarry kilns hurling hot cinders and igniting oil-soaked brush.
Kneaded from furnace soot and vitrified glass-slag by rogue apprentices, these spiteful homunculi cackle like popping pine-knots until doused.

Greywood elk whose antlers became colonized by parasitic border-briar; driven mad by constant pain, they attack anything moving along logging roads.

Fattened on damp grain sacks in Thornwick's lower cellars, these mangy rodents travel in disciplined packs led by scarred, half-blind alphas.

title: Parish Debt-Shade

p: Phases through wooden barricades to chill targets and drain mana with spectral tally-chains.
Bound to the Sunken Sanctum by unpaid mortuary liens, these translucent clerks endlessly rattle phantom coins while seeking living debtors to replace them.

Six-legged cave scorpions whose flat backs resemble cracked limestone slabs; miners tap every ceiling beam with iron picks before entering old galleries.

title: Ashbrook Scarecrow
summary: Stands immobile in burned turnip rows before lashing out with rusted scythe-blades when flanked.

p: Stands immobile in burned turnip rows before lashing out with rusted scythe-blades when flanked.
Stuffed with hex-soaked straw and mounted on stolen levy pikes by Coven raiders to guard the smoldering approaches to Ashbrook Manor.

title: Mire-Toad Bloater
summary: Puffs its throat sac to belch clouds of stinging marsh-bile across narrow boardwalks.

p: Puffs its throat sac to belch clouds of stinging marsh-bile across narrow boardwalks.
Wart-backed amphibians thriving in stagnant fen-ditches; their acidic skin mucus blisters bare hands and corrodes ungreased chainmail.

title: Undervault Rust-Slug
summary: Crawls slowly along damp brick arches, secreting an enzyme that pits iron weapons on contact.

p: Crawls slowly along damp brick arches, secreting an enzyme that pits iron weapons on contact.
Pale, blind mollusks bred by dwarven smiths to clear slag-scale from drainage pipes, now overgrown into arm-thick pests in abandoned tunnels.

title: Gnoll Torchbearer
summary: Hurls pitch-soaked firebrands at wooden palisades and buffs nearby raiders with howling war-chants.

p: Hurls pitch-soaked firebrands at wooden palisades and buffs nearby raiders with howling war-chants.
Marked with soot-streaks across their snouts, these pack-leaders carry iron braziers filled with pine resin to burn out stubborn border pickets.

title: Alkali Dust-Devil
summary: Spins rapidly across salt-pans, blinding archers with stinging white grit and deflecting arrows.

p: Spins rapidly across salt-pans, blinding archers with stinging white grit and deflecting arrows.
Born where ruptured wardstones leak static into dry desert thermals, these shrieking vortices strip paint from shields and choke unprotected lungs.

title: Salt-Viper Spitter
summary: Coils behind red sandstone hoodoos, spitting blinding venom at casters from medium range.

p: Coils behind red sandstone hoodoos, spitting blinding venom at casters from medium range.
Chalk-white adders adapted to Redmarsh's brine flats; they concentrate ingested salt into a caustic venom that sears eyes on contact.

title: Quarry Chain-Revenant
summary: Swings twenty-foot lengths of rusted ironstone shackles in wide arcs to trip and drag infantry.

p: Swings twenty-foot lengths of rusted ironstone shackles in wide arcs to trip and drag infantry.
Drowned ironstone miners risen from the flooded Deep Quarry pit, still wearing the heavy iron collars that anchored them to the lower ledges.

title: Wardstone Spark-Wisp
summary: Orbits fractured quartz monoliths, discharging sudden arcs of static lightning into armored targets.

p: Orbits fractured quartz monoliths, discharging sudden arcs of static lightning into armored targets.
Fragments of severed climate-ward magic crackling loose from broken spires; they are drawn irresistibly to iron helms and copper-wound staves.

title: Sand-Clan Outrider
summary: Circles slow infantry columns, firing barbed horn-bow volleys before darting behind dunes.

p: Circles slow infantry columns, firing barbed horn-bow volleys before darting behind dunes.
Nomadic marksmen wrapped in ochre-dyed linen veils who know every hidden cistern and alkali sinkhole across the Redmarsh plateau.

title: Canopic Jackal-Guard
summary: Stands rigid beside sandstone vault doors until seals are broken, then strikes with bronze khopeshes.

p: Stands rigid beside sandstone vault doors until seals are broken, then strikes with bronze khopeshes.
Third-Dynasty tomb guardians sculpted from bitumen-hardened clay and animated by sealed visceral jars set behind their ribcages.

title: Brine-Scale Basilisk
summary: Fixes a single target with a calcifying glare that slows movement before lunging with crushing jaws.

p: Fixes a single target with a calcifying glare that slows movement before lunging with crushing jaws.
Eight-legged desert lizards encrusted in cubic salt crystals; their heavy eyelids reflect sunlight in blinding flashes across dry arroyos.

title: Redrock Sling-Bandit
summary: Perches high on canyon ledges, pelting exposed heads with leaden bullets that stun through light caps.

p: Perches high on canyon ledges, pelting exposed heads with leaden bullets that stun through light caps.
Deserters from Morvessa's tax-companies who turned to highway robbery along the caravan tracks, trading heavy steel for light goatskin cloaks.

title: Silt-Leech Colony
summary: Burrows beneath muddy causeways, erupting around stationary tanks to sap health and slow retreats.

p: Burrows beneath muddy causeways, erupting around stationary tanks to sap health and slow retreats.
Knotted masses of red-bellied marsh worms that hunt by sensing rhythmic boot-steps through waterlogged corduroy timbers.

title: Hex-Cairn Sentinel
summary: Pulses necrotic waves every few seconds, weakening nearby healing spells until shattered.

p: Pulses necrotic waves every few seconds, weakening nearby healing spells until shattered.
Piles of skull-topped boundary stones bound with gall-inked cords by Ashen Coven scouts to mark cursed ambush zones.

title: Dune Scorpion Stalker
summary: Clamps frontline warriors in heavy pincers while striking over its back with a paralyzing stinger.

p: Clamps frontline warriors in heavy pincers while striking over its back with a paralyzing stinger.
Ochre-plated arachnids larger than warhounds that dig shallow pits beside milestone wells to ambush thirsty pack-animals.

title: Embalmed Scribe
summary: Hangs back behind tomb guards, casting hexes that increase mana costs and rot leather armor.

p: Hangs back behind tomb guards, casting hexes that increase mana costs and rot leather armor.
Preserved Third-Dynasty clerks whose dry, resin-coated fingers still clutch bronze styluses dipped in paralyzing nightshade ink.

title: Ironheart Crossbowman
summary: Fires heavy steel-tipped quarrels from behind tower pavises, retreating to reload between volleys.

p: Fires heavy steel-tipped quarrels from behind tower pavises, retreating to reload between volleys.
Veteran mercenaries hired by Gorrathul to hold the mountain approach, drilled to shoot through narrow stone embrasures in alternating ranks.

title: Mirage-Weaver Jackal
summary: Projects shimmering heat-decoys ahead of itself to draw fire while flanking isolated healers.

p: Projects shimmering heat-decoys ahead of itself to draw fire while flanking isolated healers.
Gaunt, silver-furred desert canines whose hollow guard-hairs refract harsh plateau sunlight into confusing double images.

title: Tar-Pit Crawler
summary: Slouches out of bubbling bitumen seeps, slinging sticky pitch globs that root units and amplify fire damage.

p: Slouches out of bubbling bitumen seeps, slinging sticky pitch globs that root units and amplify fire damage.
Animated clots of natural asphalt and bleached animal bones that rise near volcanic fault-lines along the Deep Quarry rim.

title: Kelp-Wrapped Drowned
summary: Wades ashore with the rising tide, entangling melee fighters in wet, strangling sea-wrack.

p: Wades ashore with the rising tide, entangling melee fighters in wet, strangling sea-wrack.
Sailors lost when Vesperion's blockade sank merchant sloops in the Greywash; barnacles crust their swollen mail and broken oars.

title: Harbor Privateer
summary: Uses boarding hooks to pull casters out of formation before slashing with heavy cutlasses.

p: Uses boarding hooks to pull casters out of formation before slashing with heavy cutlasses.
Cutthroats crewed from Iron Coast smuggler coves who fight barefoot on wet timber decks for a share of salvaged guild silver.

title: Razor-Gull Flock
summary: Dives relentlessly on wounded targets, inflicting bleeding scratches and disrupting spellcasting.

p: Dives relentlessly on wounded targets, inflicting bleeding scratches and disrupting spellcasting.
Coastal scavenger birds grown bold and vicious feeding on floating wreckage after the burning of Harborwatch.

title: Barnacle-Shell Golem
summary: Advances slowly with high physical resistance, periodically venting scalding steam from chest cracks.

p: Advances slowly with high physical resistance, periodically venting scalding steam from chest cracks.
Tidal reef-stone cemented together by millions of razor-edged barnacles and woken by drowned chapel bells.

title: Sea-Cave Lurker
summary: Clings to wet cavern ceilings above tidal causeways, dropping onto stragglers with paralyzing tentacles.

p: Clings to wet cavern ceilings above tidal causeways, dropping onto stragglers with paralyzing tentacles.
Translucent, multi-armed cephalopods that crawl out of deep Atlantic fissures during equinoctial spring tides.

title: Oakhaven Turncoat Adept
summary: Channels arcing lightning bolts between metal-armored units and erects static barriers.

p: Channels arcing lightning bolts between metal-armored units and erects static barriers.
Expelled tower-apprentices who sold Oakhaven's sea-gate cipher-bells to the Black Fleet for chests of foreign gold.

title: Wreck-Hull Mimic
summary: Disguises itself as a washed-up sea-chest or pitched cargo barrel before snapping shut on looters.

p: Disguises itself as a washed-up sea-chest or pitched cargo barrel before snapping shut on looters.
Ship-timber parasites that fuse splintered oak planks and rusted iron bands around a gaping, teeth-lined maw.

title: Brine-Phantom
summary: Floats above deep water ignoring terrain obstacles, chilling targets with ghostly fog-touch.

p: Floats above deep water ignoring terrain obstacles, chilling targets with ghostly fog-touch.
Restless spirits of lighthouse keepers and lock-wardens drowned at their posts during coastal storms.

title: Fumarole Cinder-Crab
summary: Scuttles out of steaming basalt vents above Oakhaven, spitting boiling seawater at close range.

p: Scuttles out of steaming basalt vents above Oakhaven, spitting boiling seawater at close range.
Red-shelled coastal crabs whose carapaces are fused with volcanic glass grit from feeding near underwater vents.

title: Black-Fleet Marine
summary: Advances behind copper-plated boarding shields while hurling glass incendiary flasks.

p: Advances behind copper-plated boarding shields while hurling glass incendiary flasks.
Disciplined naval infantry of Lord Admiral Vesperion, clad in salt-proofed brigandine and trained to storm sea-walls under fire.

title: Siren Buoy-Bell
summary: Tolls a hypnotic maritime chime that pulls nearby units toward deep water hazards.

p: Tolls a hypnotic maritime chime that pulls nearby units toward deep water hazards.
Corroded bronze channel-markers enchanted by Vesperion's navigators to lure relief ships onto the Greywash reefs.

title: Gallows-Crow Matriarch
summary: Circles above Night Orchards, screeching to buff undead minions and peck at blinded foes.

p: Circles above Night Orchards, screeching to buff undead minions and peck at blinded foes.
Huge, ragged-winged ravens nested in the crooked branches of hanging-trees, bearing silver rings stolen from corpses.

title: Floodgate Rust-Hound
summary: Sprints along narrow iron catwalks, biting through shields and shredding armor.

p: Sprints along narrow iron catwalks, biting through shields and shredding armor.
Clockwork watch-beasts built by Oakhaven engineers from spare lock-gears and spring-steel to guard canal capstans.

title: Tidal Undine-Wraith
summary: Surges forward in a wave of freezing surf that knocks back frontline pikemen.

p: Surges forward in a wave of freezing surf that knocks back frontline pikemen.
Condensed spirits of winter Atlantic gales trapped inside shattered lighthouse prisms along the sunken coast.

title: Catacomb Ghast
summary: Exhales a grave-stench aura that saps stamina regeneration while clawing ferociously.

p: Exhales a grave-stench aura that saps stamina regeneration while clawing ferociously.
Flesh-eating horrors dwelling in the sea-caves beneath Baron Vane's manor, fattened on smuggled prisoners.

title: Slag-Vein Hound
summary: Leaps across magma cracks, leaving burning paw-prints and biting with white-hot obsidian fangs.

p: Leaps across magma cracks, leaving burning paw-prints and biting with white-hot obsidian fangs.
Four-legged magma constructs shaped like gaunt mastiffs, bred in Ironcamp's floor-fissures to hunt deserters.

title: Ember-Court Inquisitor
summary: Brands targets with searing runes that detonate if the victim casts a spell within four seconds.

p: Brands targets with searing runes that detonate if the victim casts a spell within four seconds.
Ash-robed judges of the Crown of Order carrying red-hot iron censers to purge unorthodox ley-channelers.

title: Obsidian Gargoyle
summary: Perches motionless on basalt battlements until enemies pass, then dives with razor-sharp wings.

p: Perches motionless on basalt battlements until enemies pass, then dives with razor-sharp wings.
Winged sentinels carved from volcanic glass by First Watch masons to guard the upper approaches to the caldera.

title: Caldera Ash-Wraith
summary: Reforms from drifting cinders unless slain with cold or astral magic, choking lungs with soot.

p: Reforms from drifting cinders unless slain with cold or astral magic, choking lungs with soot.
Echoes of scholars who followed Malrik into the volcanic fissures and burned to cinders reading forbidden veins.

title: Magnetic Iron-Golem
summary: Pulls metal-armored warriors inward every few seconds while slamming the ground with lodestone fists.

p: Pulls metal-armored warriors inward every few seconds while slamming the ground with lodestone fists.
Hewn from raw lodestone in the Magnetic Narrows, these hulking guardians turn heavy plate armor into a fatal liability.

title: Cinder-Vanguard Halberdier
summary: Holds narrow obsidian bridges in tight formation, hooking shields and thrusting with burning polearms.

p: Holds narrow obsidian bridges in tight formation, hooking shields and thrusting with burning polearms.
Handpicked heavy infantry of Ashkarath's inner guard, their meteoric armor quenched in sulfur brine to shrug off fire.

title: Fissure Wyvern
summary: Straifes battlements with toxic sulfur-spit and lashes tails tipped with glowing slag-barbs.

p: Straifes battlements with toxic sulfur-spit and lashes tails tipped with glowing slag-barbs.
Leathery-winged ridge predators that nest in warm volcanic chimneys above the Gauntlet of Iron.

title: Penitent Flagellant
summary: Charges recklessly swinging red-hot censer chains, growing faster and deadlier as its health drops.

p: Charges recklessly swinging red-hot censer chains, growing faster and deadlier as its health drops.
Renegade zealots who broke away from Brother Elias, searing their own flesh with coals to prove devotion to the Primordial Ember.

title: Void-Rift Stalker
summary: Teleports behind backline casters from shimmering air-cracks, slashing with silver-edged claws.

p: Teleports behind backline casters from shimmering air-cracks, slashing with silver-edged claws.
Predators drawn through weakening Anchor Seals near the Threshold Nave, visible only as heat-shimmer until they strike.

title: Magma-Slug Behemoth
summary: Crawls slowly across basalt bridges, leaving wide trails of molten slag that block infantry advances.

p: Crawls slowly across basalt bridges, leaving wide trails of molten slag that block infantry advances.
Armored volcanic mollusks feeding on sulfur crusts along the citadel's magma moat; their shells glow dull cherry in the dark.

title: Threshold Sentinel
summary: Projects a rotating arcane shield that reflects frontal projectiles while firing astral beams.

p: Projects a rotating arcane shield that reflects frontal projectiles while firing astral beams.
Tall bronze-and-obsidian automatons left by the First Watch to test whether claimants to the dais possess true discipline.

title: Soot-Lung Leech
summary: Drops from ash-choked rafters onto distracted archers, draining mana and inflicting coughing stuns.

p: Drops from ash-choked rafters onto distracted archers, draining mana and inflicting coughing stuns.
Blind, charcoal-grey parasites thriving in the warm chimneys of Ironcamp's outer bastions.

title: Balefire Pyromancer
summary: Calls down delayed pillars of white caldera flame on clustered squads while shielded by ember-wards.

p: Calls down delayed pillars of white caldera flame on clustered squads while shielded by ember-wards.
High-ranking defectors from the Crown College who traded their eyesight for the ability to read subterranean magma currents.

title: Anchor-Chain Specter
summary: Tethers itself to a party member, transferring half of all damage it takes to the bound victim.

p: Tethers itself to a party member, transferring half of all damage it takes to the bound victim.
Unquiet spirits of First Watch wardens chained to the seven meteoric valves, bound by oath to test all who approach.

title: Redglass Hatchling
summary: Darts swiftly in packs around elder drakes, snapping with molten-glass jaws that inflict heavy bleed.

p: Darts swiftly in packs around elder drakes, snapping with molten-glass jaws that inflict heavy bleed.
Newly hatched ridge-drakes whose wing-membranes have not yet hardened into full obsidian plates, making them fast and vicious.
